Sources, credits, and the figures left out.

A civic guide is only as good as its paper trail. This page records where the facts, maps, and photographs come from, and where the official record disagrees with itself.

Last reviewed against the municipal site in November 2026. Official pages can change without notice.

Two figures not published here.

The Municipality of Ibaan publishes two profile pages. They do not agree on elevation or on the distance to Manila. Rather than choose one silently, this guide leaves both out.

Elevation

The municipal profile gives 178 metres above sea level. The geography section of the same site gives 124 metres. This guide leaves both out until the municipality resolves the discrepancy.

Distance to Manila

The municipal profile gives 96 kilometres. The geography section gives 118 kilometres. This guide leaves both out and keeps the shorter, consistent distance to Batangas City: 13 kilometres.

The distance to Batangas City, 13 kilometres, appears in the municipal profile and does not conflict across the two pages. It is the only distance figure used on this site.

The source groups.

Every factual claim on this site should be traceable to one of these groups. If you find something that is not, treat it as a mistake and check the official page.

Municipal profile and public record

All municipal facts on this site come from pages published by the Municipality of Ibaan. Population and household figures are the 2020 census values as stated in the municipal profile.

Map boundaries

The barangay and Batangas maps use the PSA/NAMRIA 2023 administrative boundaries published in the barangay-boundaries-repository. The polygons are simplified for the web, so they are for orientation, not survey work.

  • Boundary repository ↗

Map generation

Source

PSA/NAMRIA 2023 administrative boundaries, published in the barangay-boundaries-repository. The repository is MIT-licensed.

Simplification

The boundary file is published at roughly 500-metre simplification. It is suitable for orientation, but not for measuring land, settling jurisdiction, or drawing a legal boundary.

Ibaan view

The 26 barangay polygons are projected into a local SVG viewBox. The raised faces are extruded SVG paths: their height follows the mapped area in that simplified file, not official land area or population. Switch to the flat view for the plain outline.

Batangas view

The provincial context map combines the 29 municipalities and 5 component cities of Batangas in the same source release. Ibaan is highlighted; the five neighbouring local governments are labelled.

Typefaces

The site uses Source Serif 4 for display and Public Sans for text, both self-hosted. Both are open-source typefaces released under the SIL Open Font License.

Open data

The town profile, barangay list, and map-derived fields are available as JSON. The map data is generated from the boundary source above and carries the same caveat: approximate geometry for orientation.

Independence

Better Ibaan is not affiliated with the Municipality of Ibaan. It is not an official government website. It has no advertising, no analytics, and no user accounts.
